session_read: Third consecutive deep run on one set of prices. 2026-09-07 was Labor Day, so the last completed session was Friday 2026-09-04 and every quote here is that close. The book's entire -$112.61 move is currency: FX +$400.23 against an unchanged-price residual of -$512.83, flow $0.00. What is genuinely new this run is not price but structure. Three cluster ladders were built for the first time, and all three disagree with the price-derived rotation proposals they were meant to govern. In semis the laggard moved from AMD to INTC, and the AMD->NVDA pair retired. In optics the ladder ranks AVGO second of seven and states plainly that the -13.31pp reading behind the open Sell-AVGO proposal is a benchmark artifact. Separately, smith-signals withdrew four PEER LEADER flags that existed only because the peer cache was empty and the script had fallen back to SMH. Two independent lines of evidence, one conclusion: this desk has been measuring several of its names against the wrong benchmark. The proposal scorecard is the uncomfortable half -- 27.6% overall on n=29, and 18.2% on trims with an average benefit of -12.19%. Every proposal written today carries a benchmark anchor for the first time, so the next scorecard can finally separate alpha from beta.
